ProductBearer.description: Verified product user identity. Reference adapter accepts explicitly configured per-user opaque credentials; replaceable with the product's identity verifier. Never trust X-User-ID.

text.description: At most 4000 UTF-8 bytes; required unless choosing a candidate.

shorten_by_ms.description: Trim only. Relative duration reduction, computed by Go in operation order; mutually exclusive with duration_ms.

source_id.description: Insert only: existing clip to copy; target_id is new.

Operation.description: Go enforces operation-specific fields. Trim requires exactly one of duration_ms (final duration) and shorten_by_ms (relative reduction computed by Go against ordered working state); move requires start_ms; delete only target_id; caption at least one changed field. Insert requires source_id, a new unique target_id, same-kind unlocked track_id and start_ms; Go validates copied source bounds and overlap.

oneOf.description: Model-only response to editing/workbench consultation; no operations, preview or mutation.
